label: L-05
title: setRoute requires only swap_type != 0 on executed hops; Router NG v1.1 dispatches 1..8 and reverts 'Bad swap type' otherwise, so a swap_type >= 9 route is stored as valid and reverts every harvest that sells that token
borderlineNote: Low vs QA. Floor is QA (fail-loud on an attended owner path is not a defect per se; all upstream agents proposed QA). Chose Low because harvest() is public and the denial reaches third-party callers, and the validation advertised by story-007 is what lets it through. Severity-auditor may downgrade to QA without loss of recall; ceiling is Low.
description: Executed-hop swapParams validation checks presence (swap_type != 0) rather than the immutable router's accepted range (1..8). i/j/pool_type/n_coins and executed-hop pools are unconstrained by explicit story-007 out-of-scope; the swap_type range is NOT in that out-of-scope list.
impact: None. Availability only: every harvest that delivers the affected strategy token reverts Error('Bad swap type') until the owner re-sets the route or callers exempt the strategy. Atomic revert; forge+medusa invariants show harvester and caller balances unchanged; nothing stranded.
impactSummary: Liveness only. Every harvest delivering that token reverts Error('Bad swap type') (decodable via harvest.sh's generic Error(string) path) until the owner re-sets the route or callers exempt the strategy. Atomic: invariants confirm harvester and caller balances unchanged; no strand, no value at risk.
attackPath: 1. Precondition (owner footgun, not an attack): owner registers a route whose executed hop has swap_type >= 9, e.g. copied from tooling targeting Router NG v1.2 (9 = ERC4626) or a mis-entered field.
2. setRoute accepts it: executed-hop check is presence (swap_type != 0), not the immutable v1.1 router's range 1..8; the new 'params consistent with path' validation reads as having vetted it.
3. Test suite cannot catch it: MockCurveRouter executes swap_type >= 9.
4. Any harvest() including that strategy reverts inside router.exchange with 'Bad swap type'; harvest.sh's eth_call simulation surfaces the Error(string), so no gas is burnt on-chain.
5. Recovery: one owner setRoute call, or callers exempt the strategy meanwhile.
likelihood: low - requires an owner route slip of a specific shape; contract not yet deployed
assumptions: Non-malicious owner; immutable router is Curve Router NG v1.1 (dispatches 1..8).
externalRequirements: Owner misconfiguration; strategy holding that token included in a harvest.
severityRationale: Low, not QA: a real, reachable function impact (one strategy's harvests blocked) behind a validator that creates false confidence and a mock that hides it, i.e. a mild non-obvious footgun of the same class as L-03 (Low). Not Medium: fail-loud, atomic, zero value at risk, simulated before broadcast, fixed by one owner call. Distinct from M-01 (silent strand) and not an incomplete fix of it.

instances.note: says executed rows 'dispatch on a real swap_type', which the check does not establish (LOCAL-006)
test-side blind spot tracked under Q-06 sub-issue 4

relationToM01: Not an incomplete fix of M-01: M-01's root was a SILENT strand; this residual is fail-loud. Distinct rootCauseClass and mitigation. Story-faithfulness: story-007 Goal sentence claims more than its spec block delivers; recorded here as a cross-reference, not a separate F (no double-count).
faithfulnessNote: story-007 Goal sentence overclaims what its spec block validates; recorded as cross-reference on this row only (no separate F, no double count).
safeConfigGuidance: Until fixed: only register swap_type values 1..8 for the v1.1 router; eth_call router.exchange (or a harvest simulation) with the stored route before relying on it. Fix: bound executed swap_type to 1..8 in setRoute and make MockCurveRouter revert outside 1..8.
recommendation: Bound executed swap_type to 1..8 tied to the immutable router version, with an explicit check (`uint256 st = swapParams[h][2]; if (st == 0 || st > 8) revert InvalidRouteSwapType(h, st);`, with `error InvalidRouteSwapType(uint256 hop, uint256 swapType)` and a `MAX_SWAP_TYPE = 8` constant, as in qa-report.md L-05). Do not use the `swapParams[h][2] - 1 >= 8` idiom: under checked arithmetic it panics 0x11 on swap_type == 0 instead of returning the custom error. Add the new selector to harvest.sh KNOWN_ERRORS, and make MockCurveRouter revert outside 1..8; or document that setRoute validates path shape only and operators should eth_call router.exchange before registering.
severityNote: Severity: QA (reclassified from Low by owner triage 2026-10-26 — fail-loud, atomic, caught by wallet/eth_call preview so no caller gas is lost). Previously: classifier Low (borderline); severity auditor recommended QA/NC.
